elements.element: Carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "indemnification obligations under Section 8, a party's breach of its confidentiality ... gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud"

reasons: The replacement conforms IBM's cap limb exactly to the preferred formula (greater of USD 1,000,000 or fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim), correcting the paid-only, first-claim anchor.

The single inserted Section 9.3 supplies every required uncapped carve-out on a mutual basis and the payment-obligations-are-not-damages statement, and expressly overrides the records/data exclusion in 9.1(c)(2).
Mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages already existed and was correctly left untouched; the Customer-side cap was left lower, which benefits our party and is properly not flagged.
Minimality holds: one targeted text replacement plus a concise insertion for the absent Excluded Claims clause; no boilerplate or whole-clause rewrite.

Minor, non-flagging notes: the Excluded Claims override is scoped to "this Section 9" only, so the separate Section 10 consequential-damages exclusion continues to apply to Excluded Claims, and the Customer-side cap remains textually asymmetric (paid charges / first claim).
